notes_for_editor: Build date is not stated anywhere; the ARGenWeb caption (1933-1934 CCC pictorial review) is the only early date and it is not a construction date. The last description of the tower is the 1956 survey. Removal date unknown. Buck Knob now hosts communications equipment under Forest Service permits (2016 and 2020 decisions); whether the public can reach the site is not described. No staffing or fire sources found. height_m 15.2 matches the NGS 50-foot figure already in the brief.
